title: 0815software composition registry
description: Machine-readable description of every business module and every Platform Service in this repository. It is the single source of truth for composing a customer stack: deploy/provision.mjs, deploy/smoke-stack.mjs, the marketing catalogue (src/data/modules.ts) and both demo hubs derive from it. Presentation copy (blurbs, overviews, screenshots) deliberately stays out — see src/data/modules.ts.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only on a breaking change to this schema. A generated manifest.json records the version it was produced from.

services.description: The ten Platform Services. Modules reference them by id.

modules.description: The business modules, in catalogue order (MOD-01 … MOD-14).

id.description: Directory name under platform/ — also the SERVICE build arg for deploy/Dockerfile.

label.description: Short human label used in generated docs and demo hubs.

routePrefix.description: Subpath Caddy reverse-proxies to this service on the platform domain.

urlEnv.description: The env var a consumer sets to point at this service. Modules declaring this service get it wired to the internal container URL.

tickDriven.description: True when the service needs POST /api/tick to make progress. A stack containing no tick-driven service needs no ticker sidecar.

secrets.description: Secrets that must be generated per stack for this service. Names match the service's own env vars.

id.description: Directory name under modules/ — also the MODULE build arg for deploy/module.Dockerfile.

slug.description: URL slug of the module's marketing detail page.

title.description: Catalogue title as rendered on the marketing site.

label.description: Short operational label. Lowercased it becomes the module's subdomain in a generated stack (Invoicing -> invoicing.<domain>), so it must be unique across modules.

scope.description: Typical delivery scope shown in the catalogue, e.g. "3–4 WKS" (en dash).

required.description: Services without which the module refuses to function. Empty for every module today: platform coupling is opt-in and every hook degrades gracefully (server/platform.ts returns noopPlatform when unconfigured). Do not promote a service here to express "nice to have".

optional.description: Services the module integrates with when their URL is configured.

required.description: Module-specific values an operator must supply; provisioning emits FILL-ME-IN placeholders for them and lists them in its summary.

optional.description: Module-specific values with a working default.

secrets.description: Secrets generated per module per stack (never shared, never a repo default).

constraints.description: Deployment constraints a generator must honour. Each maps to exactly one env var the module reads, so it cannot drift from the code.

supportsSso.description: The module delegates login to PS-01 when IDENTITY_URL is set. False for the domain-user modules whose end users are not PS-01 principals (see docs/PLATFORM-READINESS.md, item C1) — do not set IDENTITY_URL for those.

needsPublicBaseUrl.description: The module mints externally shared links and needs PUBLIC_BASE_URL set to its real customer-facing URL, never an internal container hostname.

needsSourceDb.description: The module reads another module's SQLite file through SOURCE_DB_PATH, opened read-only, and refuses to boot when the path is set but missing. A generator must be told which module's volume to mount read-only.
